name: mirage
text: I can see why. Novig is telling the account to slow down: the engine log at 18:05 UTC says 'Novig asked us to slow down' on the bid pass, and both engine bets just now ($1.64 and $3.21) were FILLED by Novig but the fills could not be read, the same error you get on hand bets. So the orders are going through; what fails is reading them back. The cause is volume: the engine's bid desk is reposting hard (688 bids resting, 204 posted and 255 taken down in one pass, 2,429 waiting), and Novig counts that against the one shared account allowance your phone also uses. Check your Tracker or Novig before re-betting: filled means filled. I have not changed anything yet. Next I will cut the bid churn (stop taking down and reposting bids that barely moved) so reads have room, and make hand bets read their fill first. I'll tell you what I change.
